Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded that a single paper met the criteria without verifying key details on OpenReview (whether it was actually a NeurIPS 2022 accepted paper and whether “certain” referred to a recommendation rather than reviewer confidence). This led to an unsubstantiated count and ignored the need for a comprehensive search across all “Yuri” authors and proper interpretation of OpenReview fields.
